description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the "AcknowledgementsJsonParser" class, verifying JSON parsing logic for acknowledgment objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various aspects including handling of missing or invalid fields, validation of entity types and IDs, and correct parsing of acknowledged JSON structures.

classes.name: AcknowledgementsJsonParserTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying JSON parsing functionality of AcknowledgementsJsonParser, including error handling and correct data extraction from JSON structures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and parser instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the parser class and its related classes are immutable.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullAcknowledgementJsonParser
methods.description: Validates that passing null to the getInstance method results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures that parsing a null JSON object throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseJsonWithSeveralAcksOfSameLabel
methods.description: Tests parsing of JSON with multiple acknowledgments sharing the same label.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationOfNonEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies correct parsing of a valid, non-empty acknowledgements JSON.

methods.name: parseValidJsonRepresentationOfEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies correct parsing of an empty acknowledgements JSON structure.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityId
methods.description: Checks exception handling when the entity ID is missing in JSON.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutEntityType
methods.description: Checks exception when the entity type field is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidEntityType
methods.description: Checks exception when entity type is not a string.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedEntityType
methods.description: Checks exception when the entity type differs from what is expected.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks exception when Ditto headers are missing from JSON.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidDittoHeaders
methods.description: Checks exception when Ditto headers field in JSON is not a JSON object.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks exception when the acknowledgements field is missing from JSON.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks exception when the acknowledgements field is not a JSON object.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithInvalidAcknowledgementJsonRepresentation
methods.description: Checks exception when an individual acknowledgment JSON is invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithDifferentAcknowledgementEntityId
methods.description: Verifies exception thrown when acknowledgment entity ID differs from expected.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithoutStatusCode
methods.description: Checks exception when status code is missing.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnknownStatusCode
methods.description: Checks exception for unsupported status code value.

methods.name: parseJsonRepresentationWithUnexpectedStatusCode
methods.description: Checks exception when the status code read from JSON does not match expected.
